{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.index[0]

# Print the conversion rates for inspection
conversion_rates, highest_segment"}
